title: Frontend: Skeleton loaders for dashboard and timeline
description: Implement skeleton loading states for the main data-heavy views: projects dashboard and timeline tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows skeleton cards (matching ProjectCard shape) while loading
Timeline shows skeleton event rows while loading
No layout shift when data loads (skeleton matches actual content size)

steps.details: Create src/components/projects/ProjectCardSkeleton.tsx. Mirror the shape of ProjectCard using Skeleton components: a tall card with skeleton lines for name, badge, progress bar, and metadata. Render 6 skeletons in the dashboard grid while loading.
Create src/components/project/timeline/TimelineEventSkeleton.tsx. A row with a skeleton circle (dot), skeleton line for icon, and two skeleton text lines. Render 5 skeletons while loading.
In DashboardPage: if isLoading, render 6x ProjectCardSkeleton. In TimelineTab: if isLoading, render 5x TimelineEventSkeleton.
Throttle network in DevTools to Slow 3G. Navigate to dashboard — verify skeleton shows before cards load. Navigate to timeline tab — verify skeleton shows.
